title: Reset message type should be an agent method not a message
body:
`ResetMessage` should be a command that requires agent to take action to reset its state. Mixing this with other `AgentMessage` like `TextMessage` and `MultiModalMessage` causes confusion about what to do when there are multiple command messages sent through `on_messages`. 

We can refactor the message types to remove `ResetMessage` from the message types and had a `ChatAgent` method `reset()` to perform reset.

linked_prs.title: Move reset from a message to a command

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue because it involves memory initialization and resetting the agent's state, which aligns with the "Memory initialization issues" sub-category in the taxonomy. The issue directly pertains to the behavior and structure of an agent system.
